comment: Words that introduce TWO new grapheme-sound pairs at once. Gate G28
(tools/sound-load.mjs) refuses any word not on this list, and refuses any
entry here that has stopped being true. Measured 2026-08-31 against the
hundred-level ladder; nothing was added by hand and nothing may be.
heart: true marks a word the game already teaches as a sight exception, so
the child is never asked to sound it out cold. Those four are exempt by
design and are listed rather than skipped, so the exemption is visible.
The other fifteen are a TEACHING-ORDER question the owner has not yet
ruled on. They are recorded here as faults with a name, not as approvals.
Level 96 is the heaviest: six words, all asking for tu=ch and re=er
together, with no word teaching either one alone first.

words.why: heart word - taught by sight, never sounded out cold
tricky word - the game states the i says its name
the earliest plain double, and the one landing on the youngest child: an o that says short u AND a silent e, at level 7
level 48 teaches the -le ending; bb arrives in the same word
a schwa and a y saying long e together
er saying air is itself rare, paired with the new y
ie saying long u and a silent w
long u and se saying s
ou as in book plus a silent l
soft g and an ou that reduces to schwa
ch saying sh and i saying long e - both French, both new here
level 96 -ture family: tu=ch and re=er arrive together, six times over
